title: Corporate Finance Spring 2025
description:
Corporate finance is the ultimate big-picture class, looking at the first financial principles that govern how to run a business. This class is scheduled to be taught in the spring 2025 at the Stern School of Business at New York University. The first session will be on January 27, 2025 and there will be 26 sessions, with the final session on May  5, 2025. Each 80-minute session will include links to the lecture notes used during the session and a post-class test.
Webpage for the class: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar//New_Home_Page/corpfin.html
